title: (No AI) Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/gettyimages-2239561028.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Asked about AI and the trend of [college students booing tech CEOs](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/935602/graduates-boo-ai-ceos) at graduation ceremonies, Instagram head Adam Mosseri acknowledged in an interview that a lot of people really don't like AI, and it's not just young people and creatives. Appearing on the [_Colin and Samir_ podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sxizdQ2hRfk&t=3689s) to talk about the launch of [widescreen and long-form video for Instagram](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1018688/instagram-longform-widescreen-video-features-youtube), Mosseri said he thinks there's a trend of "more anxiety and more frustration and more anger about AI," particularly in creative industries:

> It's not only getting worse, it's going to continue to get worse. I think we're going to see more frustration and anger, some of it founded, some of it un …

title: (No AI) Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![A screenshot of the MPC Sample Key on a table top in a conference room.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Akai-MPC-Sample-Key.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The MPC Sample Key looks like the MPC Sample just with keys instead of pads. | Image: Akai

The MPC Sample Key isn't even formally announced yet, but Akai is already showing off what the modding community is cooking up through vibe coding. Akai has decided to embrace the [explosion of hackers and custom firmware developers](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/1013493/vibe-coding-ai-music-gear-hacking-custom-firmware) by giving them early access to the device, which will have open-source firmware.

It will likely run some version of the same software found on the [MPC Sample](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/899233/akai-mpc-sample-review), but with tweaks to accommodate the traditional keyboard, pitch, and mod wheels. Unlike the higher-end MPC Key 37, however, the Sample Key doesn't have pads. Instead, you play back samples with the keys.
